verdict.rationale: Period locking is a fair question for accounting software like Moneybird, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions closing, locking or reopening accounting periods. The items cover authentication, contacts, MCP, CLI, webhooks, sandboxes, versioning and invoicing features, none of which relate to this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
